name: osaas-e2e-test-app-native-sqlite
description: Fixture branch for osaas-e2e-tests#592: exercises a native npm module (better-sqlite3) so the build/install fails if the Node.js web-runner image lacks the node-gyp toolchain (python3/make/g++ — see Eyevinn/web-runner#60, fixed by Eyevinn/web-runner#61 / f018f3d) and the app fails at runtime if the compiled binding cannot load. Opens an in-memory DB at startup, runs SELECT 1 AS ok, and serves the result on '/'.
